## Analysis and report Winter Naked Barley 2026

Analysis of field trial planted in Madison, WI during 2026.

## Set up data

```{r}
#| label: Set Up
#| warning: true
#| include: false
# Set up code
#| echo: false

library(asreml)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

Data<-openxlsx::read.xlsx("Fildbooks/2026 FRT MAD.xlsx")

Data<- Data %>% janitor::clean_names()


Data$col<-as.factor(Data$col)
Data$row<-as.factor(Data$row)
Data$rep<-as.factor(Data$rep)
Data$ib<-as.factor(Data$ib)
Data$genotype<-as.factor(Data$genotype)

Data$test_weight_kg_h_l<-(Data$tw_g_500_m_l*200)/1000
Data$tw_b<-Data$test_weight_kg_h_l/1.247
Data$y_g_sqm<-((Data$plot_weight_kg)*1000)/(1.524*3.63)
Data$Bu_ac<-((Data$y_g_sqm/454)*4046.86)/60

Data<-Data[order(Data$col, Data$row),]
library(asreml)

asreml.options(maxit=100,extra=10) 
```

Heading Date analysis

```{r}
#| label: Heading Date Mixed Model
#| include: false


mod <- asreml(fixed = hd_julian ~ genotype + rep,
              random = ~ rep:ib,
              residuals = ~ ar1(col):ar1(row),
              data = Data, workspace = 16e8)
mod <- update.asreml(mod)

# Variance components
vc <- summary(mod)$varcomp |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Component")

# Residuals
res <- data.frame(plot = Data$plot, e = mod$residuals)
res$z <- as.numeric(scale(res$e))
worst_hi <- res$plot[which.max(res$e)]
worst_lo <- res$plot[which.min(res$e)]
n_out <- sum(abs(res$z) > 3)

# BLUEs
pred <- predict(mod, classify = "genotype", workspace = 16e8, maxiter = 100)
BLUES <- pred$pvals |>
  dplyr::select(genotype, predicted.value, std.error) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(predicted.value))

top    <- BLUES[1, ]
bottom <- BLUES[nrow(BLUES), ]
```

## Model diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: Residuals plot HD
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: Residual diagnostics from the spatial model.
plot(mod)
```

## Variance components

```{r}
#| label: Variance componenets HD
#| echo: false
vc |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(where(is.numeric), decimals = 3)
```

## BLUEs

```{r}
#| label: BLUES HD
#| echo: false
BLUES |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Heading date", subtitle = "Julian date") |>
  cols_label(genotype = "Genotype",
             predicted.value = "BLUE",
             std.error = "Std. Error") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(predicted.value, std.error), decimals = 2)
```

# BLUEs Vigor

```{r}
#| label: Vigor Mixed Model
#| include: false

Data[Data$plot == 12036, "vigor_0_9"] <- NA
 
mod_vig <- asreml(fixed = vigor_0_9 ~ genotype + rep,
              random = ~ rep:ib,
              residuals = ~ ar1(col):ar1(row),
              data = Data, workspace = 16e8)
mod_vig <- update.asreml(mod_vig)

# Variance components

  tibble::rownames_to_column("Component")

worst_lo <- res$plot[which.min(res$e)]
n_out <- sum(abs(res$z) > 3)

```

```{r}
#| label: Residuals plot Vigor
#| echo: false

```

```{r}

#| include: false

BLUES_vig <- pred_vig$pvals |>
  dplyr::select(genotype, predicted.value, std.error) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(predicted.value))

top_vig    <- BLUES_vig[1, ]
bottom_vig <- BLUES_vig[nrow(BLUES_vig), ]
```

